package.description: SAO Utils 2 provides you a fresh-new customizable Full-Dive 3D app launcher with varieties of themes, desktop widgets and powerful utilities.

en-US.description: SAO Utils 2 provides you a fresh-new customizable Full-Dive 3D app launcher with varieties of themes, desktop widgets and powerful utilities.
en-US.longDescription:
SAO Utils 2: Progressive provides you a fresh-new customizable Full-Dive 3D app launcher with varieties of themes, desktop widgets and powerful utilities.
Its pluggable architecture allows you, the developer, to add any kinds of extensions to the core program.
en-US.name: SAO Utils 2

zh-CN.description: SAO Utils 2 是全新的 Windows 桌面美化工具，除了提供丰富的 ACG 桌面挂件和小工具外，还独创的加入完全潜行的可定制 3D 应用启动菜单。
zh-CN.longDescription:
SAO Utils 2: Progressive 是全新的 Windows 桌面美化工具，除了提供丰富的 ACG 桌面挂件和小工具外，还独创的加入完全潜行的可定制 3D 应用启动菜单。
通过它的扩展框架，任何人都可以为其开发、分享脚本或配置文件，打开个性化桌面的新世界大门！
zh-CN.name: SAO Utils 2
